open_points.subject: Flow activation trigger for proven read-only versions (M18 / K-08 / primary action "activate a flow")
open_points.text: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven" (K-08) / "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once" (Primary actions)
open_points.question: Does a proven read-only flow version become active automatically at composition/proof time, or only when an explicit activate action is called?
options: Automatic activation immediately when proof is proven and highest effect class is read
Activation only via explicit "activate a flow" action request
Both: explicit action required for effectful, automatic for read-only only when activation is requested in same call path
open_points.default_guess: Activation only via explicit "activate a flow" action request.

open_points.subject: Resend authority after not_applied for draft-write effects (K-08 vs M26)
open_points.text: "a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead" (Product statement) / "An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh approval" (K-08) / "except a resend after `not_applied`, which, whatever its class, records the fresh approval it needed" (M26)
open_points.question: If a draft-write attempt is resolved `not_applied`, must the resend require a per-effect owner approval (despite draft-write normally using flow activation), or can it resend under activation/grant rules without an approval object?
options: Fresh per-effect approval is required for resend after `not_applied` for all non-read effect classes, including `draft-write`
Fresh approval rule applies only to classes that already require runtime approvals (`state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`); `draft-write` still uses flow activation
open_points.default_guess: Fresh per-effect approval is required for resend after `not_applied` for all non-read effect classes, including `draft-write`.

open_points.subject: Slot "current implementation" before any admitted activation exists (M02 / K-12 / primary actions)
open_points.text: "A slot's current implementation is that version's current activation." (M02) and "For repair an agent receives one contract, its current implementation" (K-12), while slot creation occurs on first contract issue and implementation/admission/activation are separate later actions.
open_points.question: Can a slot exist with no current implementation yet, and if so what do inspect/repair actions return for "current implementation"?
options: Yes; current implementation may be absent/null until first admitted activation
No; first contract issuance must also establish an activated implementation atomically
Yes; kernel synthesizes a placeholder implementation identity
open_points.default_guess: Yes; current implementation may be absent/null until first admitted activation.
